_doc: Grandfathered backlog for the explore_entity_lede_authored gate: explore-page entities (concept/substance/topic/element/person/event with >=1 search claim) that still DERIVE their knowledge-topic hero header from a claim answer_short instead of a hand-authored lede in entity-copy.json['topics']. Seeded 2026-08-19 with the 140 un-authored at freeze (chocolate authored the same day, excluded). An honest BACKLOG asserting only 'already deriving on 2026-08-19', never 'the derived header reads well'. It SHRINKS as ledes are authored (remove the slug here + add entity-copy.json['topics'][slug].lede). A NEW explore entity is NOT here, so it MUST ship a hand lede or the board goes RED. The backlog is currently EMPTY -- every seeded slug now carries a hand-authored lede. The file stays so the gate's grandfathering contract has a home, and so a future pre-existing entity has a documented place to go.
